about_the_game:
Story

Humans have destroyed the forest, and the animals are furious. Now squatting in the ruins of an abandoned Armageddon cult hideout, they uncover a forbidden ritual powered by malice, sacrifice, and a little graffiti. With roadkill as their fuel, it's time to summon demonkind, unleash the apocalypse, and settle the score.

Adapt to Traffic

Navigate chaotic roadkill push-block puzzles amidst waves of traffic, scoring points when vehicles successfully splat roadkill. However, each vehicle type is governed by different rules, meaning you'll have to adapt on the fly to meet each level's target scores.

Spawn, Push, Squish and Splat

Per level, pick a team from a roster of unlockable animals, each with unique abilities to reshape the puzzlefield. Juggle team members to push roadkill blocks into scoring position. Then, generate new roadkill blocks by squishing your animals in oncoming traffic. Each wave spawns a new set of animals, so keep them working to maximize the carnage.

Trash Panda Palooza

Completing high score challenges, unlock new derpy creatures of chaos, from reckless raccoons to defiant ducks. Leveraging their unique talents, rack up even higher scores to expand your cult’s ranks and fuel your vengeful ambitions.

Game Modes

  • Story Mode: Complete high scores in hand-crafted levels with a fixed number of waves while uncovering the story.

  • Endless Mode: Conquer high scores while reacting to waves of random encounters that continue as long as energy remains in your gauge. Energy is gained through successful splats, but is lost with time and bad decisions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel or AMD dual core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel or AMD dual core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Push, squish, and splat roadkill in chaotic wave-based traffic puzzles, leveraging unique animal abilities to rack up high scores. Adapt to different vehicle rules, strategize moves on the fly, and maximize carnage as you seek to master various road-themed levels.
